correctness.rationale: For the stated SSPRK(3,3) tableau and fixed k=(2,-1,-1), direct multiplication yields R_e(z)=1+z+(1/2−3e/2)z²+(1/6−e/4)z³. For real skew modes r=1,7, |R_e(i√r)|²−1 gives Q1 and Q7 with positive modewise discriminants 67/16 and 5341/16. Orthogonal decomposition makes the exact total energy defect Q_w=wQ1+(1−w)Q7, with positive leading coefficient (2107−2070w)/16 and discriminant (9216w²−14490w+5341)/16. Solving this discriminant gives w±. The sign argument yields the exact iff root condition and strict positive gap on the excluded interval. At w=2/3 the completed-square exact minimum is 223/2908 at e=422/2181. The code reproduces symbolic identities and direct stages; universality is proven algebraically.

This result is the exact nonempty energy-fraction feasibility gap for the fixed third-order SSPRK(3,3) correction family. Published mathematical record and primary-literature searches did not identify an equivalent theorem; this is best-knowledge only with acknowledged priority risks.

value.rationale: This is a motivated non-closure result for a structure-preserving integrator, not just a low-dimensional arithmetic example. Two individually energy-correctable skew modes can destroy the existence of any global scalar endpoint-weight correction when combined, and a complete nonempty interval of physical mode energy fractions and strict rational excess-energy certificate quantify the obstruction. It bears directly on multimode discretizations where assessing the highest or each individual frequency is not enough. Dimension four is the minimal natural orthogonal direct sum of two nontrivial real planar oscillators. It makes no general claim for unrelated integrators or tiny steps.
